notes: 不是固定8小时预算；每臂真实c_F/c_T/c_E不同，不能按一种成本发所有任务。
工程128F/256T/128E是拟议上限；若正确性/成本剖析不足，先报价变更，不隐瞒额外调用。
S-01六代表拟为B_star/硬/软/I1/取消统计代表/p1代表；其选择规则开发前冻结；p2等主比较在P分支覆盖。
两个检查点、无约束重复臂和共享基线可按完全相同输入/代码/输出哈希去重；原预算为不去重上界。
源码审计、功效10000MC×参数格点、计时bootstrap≥10000、编译/传输/存储另项报价，不假作免费。
A-01修订为12个共同I/分组核心臂+4个S0/I软硬桥接臂；四/八臂交互MC单独报价。全局对比冻结不阻塞家族单独准入。

confirmation.formula: 按冻结manifest逐cell求和：N_F=sum(n_split_snr*unique_full_arms); N_T=sum(n_split_snr*terminal_arms*detectors); N_E=sum(n_split_snr*refit_arms). H/structure/信息/pilot/反证各有独立cell清单。
confirmation.timing: N_timing=sum(n_timing_each_arm), n_timing>=1024且由工程方差冻结；冷热/重复策略倍数另列

worked_example.label: 仅示例，不是承诺或实际样本量
worked_example.excludes: 全部终端/拟合/计时/MC/反证等额外成本

concurrency.policy: bounded independent task only; no permanent agent team; timing GPU exclusive

unit_scope.F: full observed host input through CE/F2P/BP/LDPC; includes scorer and transfers
unit_scope.E_initial: OMP and family initial coefficients on prepared dictionary; physical-refit E is not represented

runtime_quote.rule: measure each new call subtype with finite engineering pilot before assigning its development cap; do not price physical E with initial E

engineering_actual_so_far.notes: pytest test import unavailable separately; source-v4 cache failure and A2 launcher import failure made0F; reservations keep failures/unused quota

planning_only_illustration.excludes: new arm costs, E/T/generation/compile/failures/MC/storage and confirmation; no total runtime permission inferred

operational_limits.base_dispatch: only after 5-family real engineering pilot; bounded16-block slices with explicit recipe set, finite deadline, shared reservation ledger
operational_limits.timing: one exclusive device lane, no competing jobs
operational_limits.storage: per-batch measured output rate and finite cap; verify free disk before dispatch
operational_limits.raw_harvest: only individual files <10MB; larger files remote with fullpath/SHA256/MD5
